title: Deep Learning with PyTorch: tensors to reliable model releases
summary: A full36lesson PyTorch journey with depth comparable to the TensorFlow route. The sequence teaches idiomatic autograd, data loading, training, CNNs, sequences, transformers, diagnosis, checkpoints, performance and deployment with paired framework comparisons.

lessons.title: A bounded PyTorch investigation and framework comparison
lessons.outcome: A deep-learning investigation asks a model to predict a defined target from available inputs, then tests what evidence supports using that prediction.
lessons.lab: Use three training points(1, 2), (2, 4), (3, 6) and four untouched points(4, 8)..(7, 14); name one row as the prediction unit.
lessons.verification: 3 training rows, 4 holdout rows, one prediction per row. report says arithmetic/software checked; population reliability u n established.

lessons.title: Tensors, devices, dtypes, strides and views
lessons.outcome: A PyTorch tensor has values plus metadata:shape, dtype, device, strides and gradient-tracking state.
lessons.lab: Create a2x3 float64CPU tensor from values0..5.
lessons.verification: shape(2, 3), stride(3, 1), CPU, float64. RuntimeError for incompatible trailing dimensions.

lessons.title: Linear modules, parameters and matrix contracts
lessons.outcome: A linear layer computes an affine transformation from input features to output features.
lessons.verification: outputs[[0], [2]], shape(2, 1). RuntimeError from incompatible matrix dimensions.

lessons.title: Loss functions, reductions and gradient scale
lessons.outcome: A loss is a numerical objective with a declared unit and denominator.
lessons.lab: Use residuals[1, -1, 2] against zero targets.
lessons.verification: squared entries1, 1, 4; sum6; mean2. MAE4/3; MSE2.

lessons.title: Derivatives, requires_grad and finite-difference checks
lessons.outcome: A derivative measures local sensitivity:how much a function changes for a small input change.
lessons.lab: Differentiate (w-2)**2 at w=0 using autograd.grad.
lessons.verification: derivative -4; loss4. all raise ValueError.

lessons.title: Autograd graphs, the chain rule and in-place hazards
lessons.outcome: Autograd follows the chain of tensor operations from a scalar objective back to its inputs.
lessons.lab: Use w=1, z=2*w, a=z*z and loss=(a-1)**2.
lessons.verification: z2, a4, loss9, gradient48. at new w=1.5, gradient -1 for (w-2)**2.

lessons.title: Leaf tensors, detach, no_grad and gradient accumulation
lessons.outcome: PyTorch distinguishes graph tracking from gradient storage.
lessons.lab: Create leaf w0 and intermediate2w, retain the intermediate gradient and backpropagate its sum.
lessons.verification: w leaf True; intermediate False; gradients2 and1. output still requires_grad True.

lessons.title: One optimizer step you can audit
lessons.outcome: One optimizer step is the smallest complete training experiment.
lessons.lab: Use float64x1, 2, 3, y2x and scalar w0.
lessons.verification: mean squared loss56/3. w.grad None; updated weight unchanged.

lessons.title: Batches, zero_grad and repeated updates
lessons.outcome: An epoch is a traversal of selected records; a batch is the set reduced before an update; an optimizer step changes parameters once.
lessons.lab: Partition IDs1..6 into batches of 2.
lessons.verification: three batches[[1, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6]]. epoch mean4, not5.

lessons.title: Datasets, held-out families and leakage controls
lessons.outcome: A Dataset is an interface for retrieving observations, not a guarantee that the experiment is leakage-free.
lessons.lab: Create eight records with groups A, A, B, B, C, C, D, D and values1, 3, 5, 7, 20, 22, 30, 32.
lessons.verification: length8; item0has ID0, group A, value 1. 16, 18, 26, 28.

lessons.title: nn.Module, registered parameters and explicit training loops
lessons.outcome: Annn.
lessons.lab: Build Scalar Model with weight0 and buffer offset0.
lessons.verification: one parameter weight; one buffer offset; both in state_dict. same weight object and one parameter.

lessons.title: Capstone: an auditable tiny PyTorch regressor
lessons.outcome: An auditable regressor combines data identity, a baseline, an explicit training loop and separate assessment.
lessons.lab: Use rows zero, e1, e2, e3, [1, 1, 1], [2, 1, 1] and target2a-b+c.
lessons.verification: targets0, 2, -1, 1, 2, 4. disjoint IDs; holdout count 2; explicit limited scope.

lessons.title: Binary logits, BCEWithLogitsLoss and thresholds
lessons.outcome: A binary logit is an unrestricted score.
lessons.lab: Apply sigmoid to-2, 0, 2.
lessons.verification: middle probability.5 and strictly increasing values. 0 errors at.5 and1 at.8.

lessons.title: CrossEntropyLoss, multiclass and multilabel contracts
lessons.outcome: Multiclass classification chooses exactly one outcome among mutually exclusive classes.
lessons.lab: Use one row of three zero logits and target class1.
lessons.verification: cross entropy log3. IndexError or RuntimeError identifying an invalid target.

lessons.title: Dataset, DataLoader, collation and reproducible sampling
lessons.outcome: Dataset defines how to retrieve an observation, while DataLoader defines batching, sampling and collation.
lessons.lab: Load five paired ID/value records with batch size 2 and no shuffle.
lessons.verification: sizes2, 2, 1 and IDs0..4 exactly once. ValueError before padding.

lessons.title: Initialization, nonlinearities and gradient diagnostics
lessons.outcome: Nonlinearity changes which functions a network can represent.
lessons.lab: Use inputs00, 01, 10, 11 and two rectified differences.
lessons.verification: outputs0, 1, 1, 0. both.6; the function is absolute difference.

lessons.title: Dropout, regularization, train and eval modes
lessons.outcome: Regularization and training mode affect different parts of the experiment.
lessons.lab: Use weights1, -2 and compute L1and squared L2sums.
lessons.verification: L1=3; squared L2=5. output still requires grad; backward gives ones.

lessons.title: BatchNorm, LayerNorm and stateful normalization
lessons.outcome: Normalization can introduce both state and cross-observation dependencies.
lessons.lab: Apply BatchNorm momentum.5 to rows1, 3 and3, 5.
lessons.verification: running mean1, 2; batch counter1. finite zeros with default affine initialization.

lessons.title: Convolutions, channel layouts and shared computation
lessons.outcome: Convolution applies a shared local kernel across spatial positions.
lessons.lab: Apply kernel1, 0; 0, -1 to image1..9 in3x3NCHW layout.
lessons.verification: output shape1, 1, 2, 2; all values-4. 8trainable scalars.

lessons.title: Pooling, local augmentation and label invariants
lessons.outcome: Pooling reduces local spatial information.
lessons.lab: Pool patch1, 3; 2, 4 with a2x2window.
lessons.verification: max4; average2.5. left->right->left.

lessons.title: Embeddings, padded sequences and recurrent models
concepts: P ac k e d sequence
lessons.outcome: A padded sequence contains real positions and artificial storage positions.
lessons.lab: Use IDs2, 3, 0 and a fixed4x2table with zero padding row.
lessons.verification: embedding shape1, 3, 2; mask True, True, False. RuntimeError for invalid length.

lessons.title: Attention, transformer masks and information boundaries
lessons.outcome: Attention forms weighted combinations of value vectors using query-key comparisons.
lessons.lab: Use zero3x2queries/keys and values2, 0; 0, 2; 6, 6.
lessons.verification: outputs2, 0; 1, 1; 8/3, 8/3. repeated evaluation matches.

lessons.title: Debugging custom loops, accumulation and clipping
lessons.outcome: A custom training loop can fail by disconnecting the graph, forgetting an update, reusing old gradients or applying an incorrect reduction.
lessons.lab: Detach (w-2)**2 before backward and inspect tracking.
lessons.verification: detached loss requires_grad False; backward raises RuntimeError. nonnegative and below56/675.

lessons.title: Capstone: a small classifier with honest evaluation
lessons.outcome: A classifier capstone must connect the task definition to training and evaluation evidence.
lessons.lab: Use training x-2, -1, 1, 2 with labels0, 0, 1, 1 and test x-3, 3.
lessons.verification: 4training records, 2test records. negative0/1errors; positive1/1.
